people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Taanach
people.line: Canaanite city allotted to Manasseh, later a Levitical city

translations.web: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
translations.bsb: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh the rest of the clans of the Kohathites were given Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands.
translations.kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
translations.asv: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its suburbs, and Bileam with its suburbs, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
